verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack discusses data retention policies, deletion controls, export/erasure APIs, or any privacy-posture controls for AI-native users; the docs cover webhooks, integrations, changelogs, and editor features unrelated to retention/deletion. missing for 10: documentation on data retention settings, user/account deletion or data export mechanisms, GDPR/CCPA deletion request handling, or any API/UI controls for purging AI-processed data.
